resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or another open-source plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source DFT package; the agent may use any functionally equivalent code (e.g., ABINIT, CP2K) as long as it can perform full structural relaxations with P1 symmetry.

resources.notes: Required to run the DFT relaxations.

access.notes: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Li, Ti, V, P, As. The agent may use alternative well‑tested pseudopotential sets (e.g., SSSP, PSlibrary) as long as they are optimized for GGA‑PBE.
